_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Hardware, Software and Firmware Utilization Matrix (HSFUM)
summary: The HSFUM documents all hardware, software, firmware, support and test equipment, and program deliverables with their need dates, pedigree, quality level, qualification status, and locations.
use_relationship:
The Hardware, Software and Firmware Utilization Matrix (HSFUM) documents all hardware, computer software, firmware, Peculiar Support Equipment (PSE), Special Inspection Equipment (SIE), Special Test Equipment (STE) and program deliverables (hardware, computer software, firmware) with associated need dates and their pedigree, quality level, qualification status and locations. This includes test and production articles, spares, Stockpile Reliability Program (SRP) assets, items for development labs, computer software etc.
The document also identifies hardware planned to be reused or destroyed through testing in a test article trace through each planned test event to track the pedigree, cycles, and heritage of the unit under test.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The HSFUM shall be delivered in a Microsoft Excel file with tabs appropriate for the program.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: Tabs in the HSFUM Excel file shall include:

children.title: Cover.
children.content: Include security classification marking in accordance with DoD Manual (DoDM) 5200.01 Volume 2, DoD Information Security Program: Marking of Information (this document is available online at www.esd.whs.mil/DD), title, date, program name, contract number, record or document identification number, contractor name and address, distribution statement in accordance with DoD Instruction (DoDI) 5230.24, Distribution Statements on Technical Documents, Enclosure 4 (this document is available online at www.esd.whs.mil/DD).

children.title: Revision History.
children.content: Include a table that shows revision history to include revision number, date of revision issuance, approval organization, HSFUM tabs affected, and description of change.

children.title: Acronym List and Definitions.
children.content: Identify all acronyms and define all key terms listed within the HSFUM.

children.title: Prime hardware tab(s).
Peculiar Support Equipment (PSE), Special Test Equipment (STE), and Special Inspection Equipment (SIE) tab.
children.content: The PSE-STE-SIE tab must clearly identify all weapon system PSE-STE-SIE needed for development, manufacturing, integration, and sustainment as well as any spares and PSE-STE needed for development labs and associated need dates for all items. Include verification status of assets and location where assets are needed. Include other columns based on contractor design (e.g., separate PSE/STE/SIE by product or component level).

children.title: Software tab.
children.content: Identify software name and use, software build information, software capability, and where software can be updated. Include other columns based on contractor design. Identify Authority to Operate Approval Date.

children.title: GFx tab.
children.content: To facilitate activities above, identify Government Furnished Equipment and Contractor Acquired Property (CAP), Information, Data, etc. with the associated need date, as well as activity(ies) impacted and approved Rent Free Non-Interference Use Agreements (provide agreement control number, approval date and copy of the agreement). Provide DD250 Form Material Inspection and Receiving Report invoice number and date of equipment and property.
